message.content:
This editorial illustration features the masthead "TEMPO" in white serif letters across the top. Below the title, a stylized outdoor scene is framed by dark green, textured, arched foliage. Centrally, a man wearing a white shirt, blue pants, and a white turban rides a red bicycle across a grassy yellow slope. He faces right toward a red, tiered building topped with a silver dome and crescent moon. This building has two rectangular solar panels on its sloping walls. 

The background includes three-bladed wind turbines, lush green tropical plants, and a light blue sky with wispy clouds. In the foreground, stylized dark green and purple leaves with red patterns appear. Text in the bottom right corner reads "EDISI KHUSUS LEBARAN" and "PESANTREN PROGRESIF" in bold black letters, followed by a paragraph of smaller black Indonesian text ending with "H.30". Additional headings at the top read "Salah Kelola Aset Unesa H.26" and "Waswas Inflasi Pangan H.92". A barcode and "2-8 MEI 2022" are located in the upper right. All objects are rendered in a flat, painterly illustration style.
